scientific_goal: Preserve the 0p10 TCN63 checkpoint's improved held-out one-step prediction while learning stable autonomous stochastic rollouts. Screen every fine-tune for 1000 native steps at full noise; only broadly reasonable candidates receive detailed innovation diagnostics and possible 50000-step confirmation.
scientific_constraints: Use finetune mode only. Start the four queued controls from the exact tcn63_parent checkpoint runs/comparison/0p10_tcn63/best.pt. Adaptive objective ablations should also use this parent unless explicitly testing continuation of a named successful arm.

Keep the unstructured TCN architecture, dense 63-token context, 64 channels, native-lag velocity update, constant diagonal diffusion parameterization, rank 20, shared basis, 50 Hz high-pass spatial mean and saved 5 percent full-stencil training trim fixed. Fine-tuning must reuse the checkpoint normalization and saved cutoff. The more recent untrimmed structured models are not the baseline.
Selection uses validation repetitions 13 and 14 only. Test repetitions 15 and 16 remain locked.

Complete the four queued three-epoch controls before adaptive tuning: one-step continuation, velocity multistep weights 0.03 and 0.1, and displacement multistep weight 0.03. All use learning rate 0.0001, batch size 128 and seed 0.

Keep one-step NLL active on all retained one-step examples. Additional multistep gradients go to drift only; ordinary one-step gradients still train drift and diffusion. No endpoint-moment, orthogonality or stability penalty is added in this study.
Score all 21 coordinates at every multistep horizon, including all 20 POD modes. Do not hide high-mode instability by reducing scored mode counts.
Use the fixed 1000-step validation screen with 8 conditions, 4 trajectories each, seed 814 and full-strength trained diffusion. Do not clip, trim, reject or rescale generated trajectories.

The hard screen gate requires every path finite, peak POD RMS in checkpoint position-standardized units <=10, maximum absolute standardized coordinate <=50, and energy and POD covariance-trace ratios within [0.25,4]. These broad limits permit further evaluation, not a scientific success claim. Inspect mean bias, modal amplitudes, late growth and PSD as well.

Only promote a passing screened candidate with preserved one-step prediction and acceptable innovation calibration/ACF. Confirmation uses independent seed 1814, 8 conditions, 4 trajectories, and 50000 native steps. A finite 1000-step rollout is not proof of long-term stability.

Training history is trim-enforced but long reference rollout windows are not. Report the quantitative summary's reference population. Never compare the 1000-step PSD directly with 50000-step frequency resolution or optimize untrimmed reference power blindly.

Use at most six training trials and two long confirmations. On repeated failure, report the failure mode and stop or request a reviewed implementation; do not keep increasing unconstrained capacity or launch an unbounded search.
advisor_guidance: The original 0p10_tcn63 checkpoint has validation one-step NLL 19.53 versus approximately 29 for the lag-1 MLP. On 4096 identical retained validation windows the TCN scored 19.58 versus 27.86 and reduced POD1 lag-one innovation correlation from 0.898 to -0.092. Nevertheless saved full-noise paths grow catastrophically within hundreds of steps and become nonfinite around 2000. Two measured-start probes stayed bounded for 5000 steps with zero or half noise, but switching noise off after escape at step 300 did not rescue any of four paths. Structured restoring-only, restoring+damping, and untrimmed restoring-orthogonality TCN runs also failed according to the user; do not repeat those arms. The current hypothesis is inaccurate feedback on self-generated histories. Compare the queued matched objective variants first, retain their separate one-step and multistep metrics, and reject merely finite but exploding or collapsed screens. The imported 500-step parent rollout is already catastrophically inflated; it is not a passing screen. After the four controls, allow at most two targeted follow-ups: e.g. a smaller weight/lower learning rate to retain local fit, or horizons 5,10,20,50 if short horizons improve prediction but not stability. Use examples-level multistep subsampling, not full-batch particle expansion, because TCN BPTT through 63-token contexts is memory-intensive. The baseline innovation diagnostic supplies a matched validation reference; successful screens get the same diagnostic. Never claim the 0p10_lag1_tcn63 directory is a 0p10 control: its saved checkpoint points to the 0p20 model. Promote only clearly justified passing candidates, otherwise use the remaining bounded training trials or stop with evidence. Review exact checkpoint/source provenance rather than relying on directory names.

seed_runs.hypothesis: The unstructured one-step TCN has improved conditional predictions but catastrophically inflated autonomous trajectories, even at 500 steps.

initial_trials.hypothesis: A matched low-learning-rate continuation tests whether further one-step optimization alone removes the instability.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Local NLL may improve, but a failed screen establishes the need for closed-loop training.

initial_trials.hypothesis: A modest short-horizon closed-loop velocity likelihood corrects accumulation of generated-history errors while retaining one-step fit.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Finite and bounded 1000-step paths with preserved validation one-step NLL and innovation ACF.

initial_trials.hypothesis: A stronger weight on the same generated paths improves recovery from excursions more than weight 0.03.
initial_trials.expected_observation: A better stability screen without destroying variance or substantially degrading conditional fit.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Endpoint displacement likelihood constrains integrated position errors more effectively than endpoint velocity likelihood.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Less amplitude growth than the matched velocity arm, retaining local prediction and noncollapsed spectra.
